spec_family.name: Interior Specialty Surface Repaint (Consolidated: Wainscot + Wood Wall + Wood Ceiling + Arch Elements + Built-ins)
spec_family.description: Consolidated prime + finish repaint spec for previously painted interior specialty millwork surfaces in occupied residential homes. Covers 7 paintable items across 5 NC source specs (SF_WAINSCOT_PANEL_NC, SF_WOOD_WALL_NC, SF_WOOD_CEILING_NC, SF_ARCH_ELEMENT_NC, SF_BUILTIN_NC). Includes condition assessment (visual scan, adhesion test, coating ID, moisture check), prep remediation (TSP wash, per-surface degloss, scrape/feather, caulk assess/repair, mildew treatment), state-driven primer selection (adhesion, stain-block, mildew-resistant, bonding for stain/clear conversion), fine-finish coat application (spray or brush per surface type), interstage inspection/sanding between every coat, and consolidated room-level protection. 58 total tasks (49 SPRP-owned + 5 shared RRP + 4 SPRP assessment). 2.65x task reduction from 154 NC tasks.

includes: Condition assessment per room covering all specialty surface types present (visual scan, ASTM D3359 adhesion test, coating identification latex vs alkyd vs stain/clear, moisture check on ceiling/wall surfaces)
EPA Lead-Safe RRP evaluation and containment for pre-1978 homes (specialty millwork is HIGH RISK for lead paint)
Surface contamination treatment (TSP wash for wax, oils, cleaning residue on all specialty surfaces)
Mildew/biocide treatment for SS_INT_MOISTURE_DAMAGE on wood ceiling and wall surfaces
Scraping loose and failing paint with contour scrapers for profiled specialty surfaces (condition-gated FAIR/POOR)
Feather-sanding all scraped edges (mandatory at all QT)
Per-surface-type deglossing (chemical deglosser or mechanical scuff 150-180 grit) with correct UOM per item
Caulk assessment and partial replacement at all specialty-to-wall/ceiling junctions
State-driven primer selection and application per surface type (adhesion, stain-block shellac, mildew-resistant, bonding for stain/clear conversion)
Fine-finish coat application: 2 coats QT3-QT4, 3 coats QT5 brush per FFD 15.10.3 (spray or brush per surface type)
Interstage inspection, sanding (QT3 spot 220, QT4 full 220, QT5 thorough 320), and defect repair between every coat
Consolidated room-level floor protection (perimeter for brush, full for spray or ceiling work)
Wall/ceiling masking at specialty-to-adjacent-surface junctions (spray method only)
Fixture masking (ceiling fixtures, switches, outlets, vents)
Built-in contents protection in occupied homes (RP-specific)
Stain/clear coat to paint conversion with bonding primer (SYS_PRIMER_BONDING)
Final quality inspection and touch-up across all specialty surfaces
Customer walkthrough and sign-off (RP-specific, occupied home context)
Wainscot panel surfaces (SF) including panels, internal rails/stiles, base rail, applied molding
Wood wall panel surfaces (SF) including board faces, panel faces, joint detail
Wood ceiling panel surfaces (SF) with overhead penalty rates
Architectural beam surfaces (LF) with 3-sided exposure and overhead penalty
Architectural column surfaces (EA) with full-height work
Fireplace mantel/surround surfaces (EA) with safe-release masking at surround junction
Built-in unit surfaces (EA) using Opening Count method with size-tier rates and depth/detail/access modifiers

excludes.item: Trim surfaces (baseboard, chair rail, crown molding, wainscot cap rail, door casing)
Drywall wall surfaces (wall field above wainscot, adjacent to wood wall panels)
Drywall ceiling surfaces (above wood wall panels, at beam/column junctions)
Structural repair (wood rot, joist damage, load-bearing columns)

excludes.route_to: Plumber/contractor — moisture SOURCE must be resolved before painting (gate condition)

excludes.item: New installations (new built-in, new mantel, new wainscot)

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier controlling coat count, inspection rigor, interstage sanding discipline, and defect tolerance. QT3 is minimum for specialty millwork. Standard global modifiers.
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT3=1.0x baseline. QT4=1.3x (standard global). QT5=1.5x + 3rd brush coat per FFD 15.10.3. No QT2 — specialty millwork is prominent/scrutinized.

configuration_dimensions.description: Primary application technique. Spray is default for SF surfaces (wainscot, wall, ceiling). Brush for detail elements (columns, mantels). Per-surface method selection supported.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Spray: production method for SF surfaces, superior finish in grooves/profiles. Brush: detail method for columns, mantels, small built-ins. Roll is NOT valid for specialty millwork. spray_backroll not applicable.

configuration_dimensions.description: Finish coating sheen. Semi-gloss is traditional millwork default. Sheen/QT gate per FFD SS4.1.
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT3: satin only. QT4: satin or semi-gloss. QT5: satin, semi-gloss, or gloss. Eggshell valid for ceiling surfaces and built-in interiors (lower scrutiny). Flat/matte NOT valid.

configuration_dimensions.description: Universal 3-level condition scale driving prep intensity. Maps from substrate state assessment.
configuration_dimensions.notes: GOOD=SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT (1.0x prep, skip prime if adhesion passes). FAIR=SS_INT_FAILING_PAINT (1.5x prep, state-driven prime). POOR=SS_INT_PEELING or SS_INT_MOISTURE_DAMAGE or SS_INT_SMOKE_DAMAGE (2.0x prep, full remediation + state-driven prime).

configuration_dimensions.description: Per-surface-type complexity modifiers transferred from 5 NC source specs. Each surface type has its own complexity dimension.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Complexity modifiers stack with condition_scale (prep pool) or quality_tier (coating pool). Height modifier (H1-H4) applies to wood wall, ceiling, beam, column. NOT applied to wainscot (always H1) or built-in (typically H1).

paintable_items.name: Wainscot panel assembly
paintable_items.counting_rules: Square footage of wainscot panel surfaces to be repainted. Includes panels, internal rails/stiles, base rail, applied molding. Cap rail excluded (covered by SF_TRIM_INT_RP as ITM_TRIM_WAINSCOT_RAIL).
paintable_items.notes: Existing item from SF_WAINSCOT_PANEL_NC. wainscot_type drives complexity modifier. Always H1 (below chair-rail height).

paintable_items.name: Wood wall panel/board surface
paintable_items.counting_rules: Square footage of wood wall panel surfaces to be repainted. Includes board faces, panel faces, internal rails/stiles (library_panel), joint detail.
paintable_items.notes: Existing item from SF_WOOD_WALL_NC. wall_style drives complexity modifier. Height varies via PS_META.HEIGHT_BAND.

paintable_items.name: Wood ceiling panel/board surface
paintable_items.counting_rules: Square footage of wood ceiling surfaces to be repainted. All tasks apply overhead penalty rates (0.70-0.80x of equivalent wall rates).
paintable_items.notes: Existing item from SF_WOOD_CEILING_NC. ceiling_style drives complexity modifier. Height modifier based on ceiling height (H1-H4).

paintable_items.name: Decorative beam
paintable_items.counting_rules: Running linear footage of exposed beam length. Typically 3 exposed faces (bottom + 2 sides). beam_profile drives complexity modifier.
paintable_items.notes: Existing item from SF_ARCH_ELEMENT_NC. Overhead factor ~0.85x baked into base rate.

paintable_items.name: Decorative column wrap
paintable_items.counting_rules: Count of columns to be repainted. Each column counted individually.
paintable_items.notes: Existing item from SF_ARCH_ELEMENT_NC. column_type drives complexity modifier. Height via PS_META.HEIGHT_BAND.

paintable_items.name: Fireplace mantel/surround
paintable_items.counting_rules: Count of mantels to be repainted. Each mantel counted individually. Includes shelf, legs/pilasters, surround molding.
paintable_items.notes: Existing item from SF_ARCH_ELEMENT_NC. mantel_type drives complexity modifier. Typically H1-H2.

paintable_items.name: Built-in unit (consolidated RP item)
paintable_items.counting_rules: Count of built-in units to be repainted. Size tier (S/M/L/XL) provided via PS_META.ENUM.BUILTIN_SIZE_TIER. Per-unit rate reflects full unit workflow: opening interiors, face frames, doors/drawers removal, flat painting, reinstall.
paintable_items.notes: Proposed item for RP consolidation. NC uses ITM_OPENING_S/M/L/XL (per opening tier) + ITM_BUILTIN_DOOR. RP consolidates to single EA per unit with size-tier rate lookup and depth/detail/access modifiers.

variants.notes: BASELINE. Most common residential specialty repaint. Sound paint, adhesion verified, compatible coating. Spray for SF surfaces. No prime. 2 finish coats.
Brush variant for small scope or occupied home preference. No prime. 2 finish coats.
Standard RP on failing paint. Scrape + feather + state-driven prime + 2 spray finish coats.
Full remediation. Heavy scrape, contamination treatment, state-driven prime + 2 spray finish coats. Highest prep labor.
Premium refresh on sound paint. Full sand 220 between coats, systematic inspection. No prime. Modified urethane enamel.
Premium remediation spray. Full prep + state-driven prime + 2 spray finish coats. Modified urethane enamel.
Premium remediation brush. Maximum prep + state-driven prime + 2 brush finish coats.
Superior refresh. 3 brush finish coats per FFD 15.10.3, thorough 320-grit interstage. No prime on sound paint. Premium urethane enamel.
Superior remediation. State-driven prime + 3 brush finish coats. Near-worst-case labor.
Maximum effort. Full remediation + state-driven prime + 3 brush finish coats. QT5+POOR gates to hourly rate recommendation (COMPAT_011). Gallery-quality finish on deteriorated millwork.

material_systems_summary.name: Interior Adhesion Primer
material_systems_summary.notes: Water-based adhesion promoter for existing coatings. Conditional on adhesion test or oil-based existing for SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT.

material_systems_summary.name: Interior Stain-Blocking Primer (Shellac)
material_systems_summary.notes: Shellac-based stain blocker. Only product that seals nicotine/smoke (RC-002). Full surface mandatory.

material_systems_summary.name: Interior Mildew-Resistant Primer
material_systems_summary.notes: Mildew-resistant primer after biocide treatment. Primary target: wood ceiling in bathrooms/kitchens.

material_systems_summary.name: Bonding Primer for Stain/Clear Coat Conversion
material_systems_summary.notes: Aggressive bonding formula for non-paint existing finishes. Full surface mandatory. No skip-prime for conversion.

material_systems_summary.name: Standard Acrylic Trim Enamel
material_systems_summary.notes: 100% acrylic enamel. Standard production grade. Satin only per sheen/QT gate.

material_systems_summary.name: Modified Urethane Trim Enamel
material_systems_summary.notes: Urethane-modified alkyd. Superior flow/leveling. Satin or semi-gloss.

material_systems_summary.name: Premium Urethane Trim Enamel
material_systems_summary.notes: Premium acrylic-urethane enamel. Maximum durability. Satin, semi-gloss, or gloss. 3 brush coats per FFD 15.10.3.

module_summary.description: Shared floor protection, wall/ceiling masking (spray), fixture covers, opening covers (ceiling spray), built-in contents protection (RP-specific)
Multi-surface condition scan, ASTM D3359 adhesion test, coating ID (latex vs alkyd vs stain/clear), moisture check. 100% RP_NEW.
Lead test, containment setup, HEPA vacuum, containment removal, waste disposal (conditional: pre-1978). Shared module — not owned by this spec.
TSP wash (shared), 7 per-surface-type degloss, scrape/feather (condition-gated), mildew treatment (condition-gated), caulk assess/repair, clean dust
State-driven primer per surface type: 2 SF spray/brush (consolidated wainscot+wall+ceiling), 4 EA/LF element tasks
Shared inspect, sand, patch, spot coat, tack, clean between every coat pair. Runs total_coats - 1 times.
Per-surface-type finish: 6 SF spray/brush (wainscot+wall+ceiling x 2 methods), 4 EA/LF element tasks
Final inspect, touch-up, remove masking, remove floor protection, remove built-in contents protection, vacuum, customer walkthrough, tool cleanup

Specialty RP — 3 Finish Coats (QT5 Brush, No Prime)
Specialty RP — Prime + 3 Finish Coats (QT5 Brush)

stacking_partition.never_cross: Prep pool never includes QT. Coating pool never includes condition_scale. Contamination drives task activation, not rate modification.

protection_zones_required.notes: Perimeter drop cloth runners at work area. Brush drip containment. Shared across all surface types.
Full floor coverage for spray overspray and ceiling drip risk. Replaces perimeter protection.
Localized work zone around individual elements. Subsumed by floor_full when spray.
Wall masking above wainscot cap rail during spray. Paper from rail up 24-36 inches.
Upper wall masking during ceiling spray. Paper/plastic from ceiling line down 12-18 inches.
Ceiling masking during wall panel spray. NOT needed if ceiling is also being painted.
Light fixtures, switches, outlets, vents. Per fixture count.
Lightweight poly cover over door/window openings during ceiling spray.
RP-specific. Poly sheeting per opening with size-tier adjustment. Conditional on contents present.

adjacent_surfaces.notes: Wall surfaces above wainscot, adjacent to wood wall panels, adjacent to built-ins. Different color/sheen typical. When spray, wall requires masking.
Ceiling above wood wall panels, at beam/column junctions. When wall spray and ceiling NOT in scope, ceiling requires masking.
Baseboard below wainscot. Typically same color/sheen. No masking when same finish.
Chair rail at top of wainscot. Typically same color/sheen as wainscot.
Crown molding at ceiling-wall junction. Typically same finish as ceiling when wood ceiling present.

valid_input_states.notes: All 5 SS_INT_* states accepted. Each drives distinct prep pathway and primer selection. Different surfaces in the same room may have different substrate states — per-surface-type state input supported. Does NOT accept SS_BARE (NC scope). Stain/clear conversion handled as condition driver with bonding primer.

output_state.notes: All input states normalize to SS_PAINTED_* after proper prep and coating. Semi-gloss is default millwork sheen.

adjacent_state_protection_rules.notes: RP walls are always finished. Full masking required for spray method.
Ceiling masking when wall panels sprayed and ceiling NOT in scope.

site_condition_rules.notes: Occupied home adds walkthrough and contents protection. Vacant RP omits both.
Pre-1978 + lead-positive activates MOD_RRP_INT_CONTAINMENT. Specialty millwork is HIGH RISK for lead paint.
active_moisture is STOP WORK. Wood ceiling in bathroom/kitchen and wood wall in splash zones are high-risk.
Mildew treatment conditional on SS_INT_MOISTURE_DAMAGE. Smoke damage requires shellac primer.

cross_spec_coordination.deduplication_note: MOD_RRP_INT_CONTAINMENT is shared across all interior RP specs — do not duplicate lead-safe tasks when running specialty RP alongside wall RP, ceiling RP, trim RP, or door RP.
cross_spec_coordination.shared_session_note: Specialty RP typically runs alongside SF_TRIM_INT_RP (cap rail, baseboard, crown). Protection zone consolidation: one shared floor protection, one shared fixture cover pass per room. Setup once, work all surfaces, teardown once. Wainscot cap rail adjacency with trim RP — tape line needed only when different finish group.

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Setup (protect) -> Assess (condition/adhesion/coating/moisture) -> RRP (if pre-1978) -> Prep (TSP, degloss per surface type, scrape, mildew, caulk, clean) -> Prime (state-driven, if required) -> Interstage -> Finish 1 -> Interstage -> Finish 2 (QT3+) -> [QT5 brush: Interstage -> Finish 3] -> Final Inspect -> Touch-up -> Teardown -> Customer Walkthrough -> Clean Tools
sequencing_notes.surface_type_sequence: When multiple surface types in scope: ceiling first (overhead drip risk), then wood wall (height-dependent), then wainscot (H1), then elements (beams, columns, mantels), then built-ins. This minimizes masking rework.
sequencing_notes.key_prohibitions: NO painting over active moisture (gate condition). NO latex primer on smoke damage (shellac only, RC-002). NO skipping interstage sanding — all tiers. Spot prime ALL scraped/repaired areas. QT5+POOR gates to hourly rate recommendation.
sequencing_notes.stain_clear_conversion_note: Stain/clear coat conversion requires SYS_PRIMER_BONDING. Full surface, no skip-prime. After first topcoat, inspect for tannin bleed-through from high-tannin species. If bleed, apply shellac spot-prime before second topcoat.

relationships.notes: Consolidated interior specialty RP spec. Combined prime+finish (no separate phases). 5 NC source specs are sibling specs with significant task adaptation. Context prefix SPRP avoids collision with NC prefixes (WNSC, WDWL, WDCL, ARCH, BLTN).

sections_used: Shellac stain-blocker mandate for smoke damage (RC-002)
SS7.2 complexity modifiers per surface type

change_log.author: SpecFactory Assembly Agent
change_log.changes: Initial spec.json assembly from 5 pipeline artifacts (research, resolution, materials, sop_modules, production). QA Critic found 1 major issue (beam finish rate range inverted — fixed), 4 minor warnings (modifier naming refinements, builtin depth value discrepancy, task count labeling, stacking threshold). 58 tasks across 8 modules (7 owned MOD_SPRP_* + 1 shared MOD_RRP_INT_CONTAINMENT), 7 material systems (4 state-driven primers + 3 QT-driven fine-finish), 4 round configurations, 9 protection zones, 5 adjacent surfaces, 19 PaintScope inputs, 10 variants, 35 proposed registry additions. Consolidated 5 NC specs (wainscot + wood wall + wood ceiling + arch elements + built-ins) into one RP spec with 7 paintable items. 2.65x task reduction (154 NC -> 58 RP). Fifth interior RP spec.
